order: 판단GT 발주문 v2 + 덧붙임 1 (세 실험 지역 먼저, 묶음 가)

frame.sign: patch outward normal positive (patch centre = 0; ALS: judgment prior height = 0)

scope.ga: buildings of buildings.json with group = experiment (experiment_sites B0_b10, B173nb_b10, R1rep_b10): 10 buildings

tile.rule: each tile point file covers its 100 m tile + 10 m buffer; patches are read per tile from the tile's own point files (as the judgment did)

forward.cell_axes: tangent1 of the patch and normal x tangent1
forward.image_cylinder_axis: patch centre and normal (judgment cylinder), h_M = median of all normal distances in the cylinder minus prior height (ALS); no outer-face rule
forward.no_prior_height: ALS patch without judgment prior height or patch without normal: '사전 정보 높이 없음' (counted, not an answer)

reverse.grid_rule: 3D grid on image points; patch centre = the image point nearest the mean of the points in the cell
reverse.evaluation_range: image points of the tile's own 100 m tile (no buffer) with XY within 1.0 m of a LoD2 patch centre of the scope buildings
reverse.normal_points: all image points of the tile file
reverse.orientation: towards the nearest training camera centre (images.bin, image_split train)
reverse.nearest_prior_patch: nearest prior surface point (patch centre + prior height x normal) among the patches of all 151 buildings of that prior; lateral and normal parts in the frame of that prior patch
reverse.tau: region, prior and roof/wall of the nearest prior patch

tau_rule: JUDGECHECK-v2 stage0 tau.json values[region][prior_kind]; ALS uses ALS_roof; equal to RELEASE-v1 tau_values.csv (multiple 1) for B0 (B0), B173nb (R2), R1rep (R1)

compare.judgecheck_v2_method: JUDGEPROBE patch_{prior}.npz j_region[:, VARIANTS.index('method') = 4], codes 0 일치 1 사전정보 사용 2 영상 깊이 사용 3 제거 4 결측 9 미판정

figure_map_display.reverse_drawn_if: nearest prior patch lateral > 0.125 m or normal > 10 m
